description: Search NIH-funded research projects in NIH RePORTER by topic, investigator, organization and fiscal year. Each row is one award for one fiscal year: a project funded for five years gives five rows, and a multi-part award gives a parent row plus one row per component (`subproject`). An investigator name matches any investigator with each word anywhere in their name; check `investigators[].profile_id` and search again with investigator_id (--investigator-id on the command line).

fiscal_year.description: One NIH fiscal year, such as 2025; all years by default.

investigator.description: Principal investigator name, such as "Pasi Janne". Each word matches any part of any investigator's name, so common names find other people; check the profile IDs.

investigator_id.description: RePORTER investigator profile ID from `investigators[].profile_id`, such as 1861387.

limit.description: Ten award rows by default, one to fifty.

offset.description: Award rows to skip in RePORTER's order; RePORTER pages at most 15,000 deep.

organization.description: Funded organization name or part of it, as RePORTER spells it, such as "DANA-FARBER".

query.description: Words that must all appear in the project title, abstract or terms, such as "KRAS G12C".

title: GrantSearch
